killedBy: stepMultiset isMultiset is derived from the registry, not from a field name
why: A valued flag is a multiset only when the registry also gives it the VALUES its list is built from. Without that half, `players`, `bots`, `level`, `seed` and `walls` all become multisets: each loses its stepper and gains a per-value count row over a `values` list it does not have, which renders as no control at all.
